templates.summary: Advisory summary for {{asof}}. These are suggestions to check before acting; nothing has been changed.
templates.nothing: Nothing was flagged in the figures you can see.

topics.label: Cancelled sales, goods taken back and price changes
Customer orders and the stock kept for them
Price lists and credit to shops

actions.text: Look at what was different on the slow days: opening hours, staff on duty, stock on the shelf and prices.
Note what went well and repeat it: the same stock on display, the same opening hours and the same offers.
No action is needed now; sales are at their usual pace.
Keep enough stock{{where}} so the best sellers do not run out.
Check that the price{{where}} still covers the buying price and is in line with the market.
Restock the items that are low or out before they cost you sales.
Check the minimum stock set for each item so the low stock warnings come in time.
Review the items that have not sold: move them to a shop where they sell, lower the price or stop buying them.
Call the buyers whose payments are past the due date and agree when they will pay.
Hold new credit for buyers who owe past the due date or are over their limit until they pay.
Open the Controls page and check who cancelled sales, took goods back or changed prices, and why.
No action is needed now; the till checks are at their usual level.
Pack and deliver the open orders, oldest first, and make sure their stock is kept aside.
Check that the price lists still give a fair margin for the buyers who use them.
Follow up the shops that buy on credit and owe past the due date or over their limit.
